mapper.select: select p.id as postId, p.post_title as postTitle, ps.post_content as postContent, tal.member_id as memberId, tak.search_word as searchWord from tbl_post p join tbl_post_section ps on p.id = ps.post_id join tbl_ai_log tal on p.member_id = tal.member_id and date(tal.created_datetime) = date(now()) join tbl_ai_keyword tak on tak.member_id = tal.member_id and date(tak.created_datetime) = date(now()) where tal.member_id = #{memberId} order by tal.created_datetime desc limit 5

select p.id as postId, p.member_id as memberId, p.post_title as postTitle, ps.post_content as postContent, k.search_word as searchWord from tbl_post p join tbl_post_section ps on p.id = ps.post_id left join tbl_ai_keyword k on p.member_id = k.member_id order by p.created_datetime desc
